title: Download your ledger as a spreadsheet
summary: Download CSV saves every ledger line and activity record of the whole campaign, archived sessions included, as a file any spreadsheet app opens.
items: The DM finds it in Review Reports → Full activity and gets the whole campaign; players find it in My Finances → Recorded transactions and get only their own characters' history.
Each row has the date, session, purse, shop, summary, type, amount in copper and in gp/sp/cp, and its receipt ID.
In a shared campaign all earlier history is loaded first; if any part cannot be loaded, nothing is downloaded and you can try again. The file is made on your device.
